raw_meta_yaml:
context:
  version: 1.1.8

package:
  name: kgcpy
  version: ${{ version }}

source:
- url: https://pypi.org/packages/source/k/kgcpy/kgcpy-${{ version }}.tar.gz
  sha256: 928867b11c81a08cb9a6724558583b33e7b7e0acd941f3576a8a47b71bd9e4dd

build:
  script: ${{ PYTHON }} -m pip install .
  noarch: python
  number: 0

requirements:
  host:
  - python ${{ python_min }}.*
  - setuptools >=61.0
  - pip
  run:
  - python >=${{ python_min }}
  - pillow
  - pandas

tests:
- python:
    imports:
    - kgcpy
    pip_check: true
    python_version:
      - "${{ python_min }}.*"
      - "*"

about:
  summary: Aids in identifying the Koeppen-Geiger (KG) climatic zone for a given latitude and longitude of any location.
  description: kgcpy Aids in identifying the Köppen-Geiger (KG) climatic zone for a given lat and lon of any location. The resolution of KG map is at 100 sec arc or approximately 3.087 km at the equator.
  repository: https://github.com/cwru-sdle/kgcpy
  documentation: https://kgcpy.readthedocs.io
  license: BSD-3-Clause
  license_file: LICENSE.txt
  homepage: https://github.com/cwru-sdle/kgcpy

extra:
  recipe-maintainers:
    - julian-belina
